summary: Allot Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on June 23, 2026, announcing a board-authorized share repurchase program of up to $40 million of its ordinary shares. The buyback may be executed from time to time in the open market, via Rule 10b5-1 trading plans, privately negotiated transactions, or otherwise. Timing and amount are subject to market conditions and other factors; the company may suspend or discontinue at any time. No price per share, premium, or specific date is stated. The program reflects board confidence in long-term strategy and intrinsic value. Watch for periodic disclosure of repurchase activity and any acceleration or modification.
